profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hello! 
   My name is Elvis Hernandez, I am excited and motivated to work in a variety of fields of technology involving software/app development as well as Database Management, Security, and finding new ways to maximize software efficiency. Growing up in Chicago and having the opportunity to work with hard working people in my past has made me motivated to tackle on and adapt to what the workforce brings in the years to come. For more information or questions, feel free to reach me through my email.

Thank you!

positions.title: Brand Ambassador
positions.description: Working as a Yerba Mate Ambacebador allowed me to connect with others in the ambassador network to collectively find marketing strategies to expose my inner network circle with the brand's product and awareness of the values and goals of Guayaki. Collecting supply from select storage locations gave me access to the product supply to give away to my social and university circle.

positions.title: Student Mentee
positions.description: I worked with diffrent engineering, architectural, and construction firms as they taught us about the operations that they work from day to day and what it takes to set plans of action in the most efficient way possible and execute them with diffrent people from diffrent areas of field, and applied them to working in our own group to redesign a hypothetical Chicago Public school in the near neighborhoods.

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description:
▪ Learned about Electrical Circuitry and worked on Audio Engineering Projects throughout the summer
▪ Worked on fixing and building audio electrical technology soldering Transformers and Amplifiers
▪ Built a microphone (with Transformer) and XLR tester for soundboard signals and
 refurbished a new circuit board to a speaker.

projects.title: CPS Renovation Project
projects.description: Worked with a team of students, architects, engineers, and construction managers all over the Chicagoland area over a span of 7 months to create a plan to reconstruct a Chicago public school. After first separating into diffrent designing, construction, and engineering groups with the help of engineers and construction managers from firms all around, each group worked for 7 months on the construction plan, budget plan, and engineered how this process were to be executed in real life. In the end, we all presented this plan proposal to all ACE faculty and family to compete with other ACE teams for the best plan proposal.
